text:
Every morning, millions of commuters must choose between riding a bicycle and driving or riding a motorised vehicle, and opinions differ on which is preferable. This essay will consider both views before explaining my own opinion.

On the one hand, supporters of cycling argue that it is cheap, healthy and clean. Cyclists keep fit and avoid traffic jams in compact cities. A worker who cycles ten minutes along a protected lane, for example, arrives refreshed and does not need to search for parking, while a driver may spend half an hour in a queue. Bicycles cost little to buy and nothing to fuel, and they produce no pollution or noise. Regular exercise reduces the risk of heart disease and improves mood, which also lowers health costs for society. In cities that offer good cycle lanes, such as Amsterdam, a large proportion of residents ride every day.

On the other hand, supporters of motor vehicles argue that they offer speed and comfort over longer distances. Cars and motorbikes are comfortable but costly and polluting, and weather, danger and distance limit cyclists. A person who lives thirty kilometres from the office, for example, cannot realistically cycle every day, and rain, heat or snow make riding unpleasant. Motor vehicles can carry luggage, children and tools, and they offer privacy and protection. In cities with poor cycling infrastructure, riders face real danger from traffic. However, congestion, parking costs and pollution reduce the advantages of cars.

In conclusion, both views have merit. Overall, I believe that bicycles are the better choice for short urban journeys when safe lanes are provided, whereas motor vehicles remain necessary for long distances and heavy loads.

plan.think: Mở bài nêu lựa chọn mỗi sáng của hàng triệu người.

Rẻ, khoẻ, sạch: giữ dáng, tránh tắc; ví dụ người đạp 10 phút trên làn bảo vệ đến nơi tỉnh táo, không tìm chỗ đỗ, khi tài xế 30 phút xếp hàng; không nhiên liệu, ô nhiễm, ồn; tập thể dục giảm bệnh tim, cải thiện tâm trạng; Amsterdam.

Nhanh và thoải mái ở quãng xa: thoải mái nhưng đắt, ô nhiễm; thời tiết, nguy hiểm, quãng đường hạn chế xe đạp; ví dụ người sống cách văn phòng 30 km không đạp hằng ngày; mưa, nóng, tuyết; chở hành lý, trẻ, dụng cụ; riêng tư; hạ tầng xe đạp kém nguy hiểm; nhưng tắc, đỗ, ô nhiễm làm giảm lợi thế.
Xe đạp tốt cho chặng ngắn có làn an toàn; xe cơ giới cho đường dài, hàng nặng.
